svg.title: Microservice Architecture cho Project Management
svg.desc: Sơ đồ kiến trúc microservice gồm API Gateway, 5 core services, message broker và shared infrastructure
svg.text: Shared infra: Service Discovery (Eureka/Consul) · Centralized Config · Distributed Tracing (Zipkin) · Logging (ELK)
